svg.title: Big Field Jumpers Co.
svg.desc: A weathered English farm sign with lettering carved into a green panel, on a wooden post. "Big Field" across the top, "Jumpers Co." across the bottom, and three white sheep jumping over a knitted jumper with the OWASP wasp on it. At the far edge of the sign, almost lost in the dark, two amber eyes are fixed on it.
